name: @penguinharness/gepa-rsi-toolkit
description: The GEPA RSI Toolkit: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning (Agrawal et al., 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457), run the way the paper does — a reflection model reads the Target's Traces and scores on a minibatch and rewrites the instruction, a child that beats its parent on that minibatch joins a pool measured on the frozen Benchmark, parents are drawn from the per-case Pareto front, and the best average is kept. Self-contained: it creates the Target's instruction slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.

penguin.description_zh: GEPA RSI 工具包：按论文《Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning》（Agrawal 等，2025，https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457）的流程运行——反思模型阅读 Target 在一个小批量上的轨迹与分数并改写指令，在该小批量上胜过父代的子代进入候选池、在冻结的 Benchmark 上测量，父代按逐题 Pareto 前沿抽取，保留平均分最高者。自成一体：自行创建 Target 的指令槽、自行评测每个单元、写入评估中心的记分板。
penguin.short_description: GEPA RSI Toolkit: evolve an instruction by reflection.
penguin.short_description_zh: GEPA RSI 工具包：经反思进化指令。

quick_start.prompt: Use the `gepa-rsi-toolkit` Skill to run GEPA on an agent of this Project: ask me for the Test Agent and the published Benchmark to optimize on, initialize the instruction slot, run the smoke budget, and report the seed and best scores.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 `gepa-rsi-toolkit` 技能在本 Project 的一个智能体上运行 GEPA：先问我被测智能体与用于优化的已发布 Benchmark，初始化指令槽，以冒烟预算运行，报告种子分与最佳分。
